description: This file implements the SessionServerAppManager class, which manages session server applications including launching, preloading, state changes, configuration, and health checks within a Rialto server environment.

classes.name: SessionServerAppManager
classes.description: Manages session server applications, handling their lifecycle, configuration, and communication within the Rialto environment.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Launches a session server application with a specified initial state and configuration.

methods.name: setSessionServerState
methods.description: Changes the state of a session server application identified by its app name.

methods.name: onSessionServerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from session servers.

methods.name: sendPingEvents
methods.description: Queues ping events to check the health of session servers.

methods.name: onAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment responses for ping requests.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection information for a specific application.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels for the session server applications.

methods.name: connectSessionServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a session server.

methods.name: configureSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a session server with necessary parameters.

methods.name: configurePreloadedSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a preloaded session server for a specific app and state.

methods.name: changeSessionServerState
methods.description: Requests a change in the session server's operational state.

methods.name: handleSessionServerStateChange
methods.description: Processes state change events from session servers.

methods.name: handleAck
methods.description: Processes acknowledgment responses for health checks.

methods.name: shutdownAllSessionServers
methods.description: Shuts down all managed session servers.

methods.name: launchSessionServer
methods.description: Creates and launches a new session server for a given app.

methods.name: preloadSessionServer
methods.description: Preloads a new session server instance.

methods.name: getPreloadedServer
methods.description: Retrieves a preloaded and connected session server.

methods.name: getServerByAppName
methods.description: Finds a session server by its application name.

methods.name: getServerById
methods.description: Finds a session server by its server ID.
